WELL CONSTRUCTION TO PRODUCTION

SWAMP WELL DELIVERY

Case study / Swamp asset, Nigeria

A COMPLETE PATH TO PRODUCTION.

A swamp appraisal and development well was drilled to approximately 7,100 ft using the SDF BR-301 swamp rig. Drilling, casing, evaluation and completion took 75.20 days, excluding rig move.

ENGINEERED ACTIVATION

  • Controlled fluid displacement to protect the formation
  • Nitrogen lifting to initiate flow through the heavy oil column
  • Gradual pressure drawdown to manage sand risk
  • Real-time flowback monitoring and well-test stabilization
  • Integrated coiled tubing, nitrogen, marine and security coordination

RECORDED PROJECT OUTCOMES

162,420 manhours worked, with zero lost-time incidents, zero accidents and zero spills. A structured cleanup and unloading programme supported the transition from well construction to production activation.
